title: partner-marketplace-qa-sprint-unblocking-playbook
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a pragmatic, sprint-focused playbook to remove final blockers for partner marketplace listings (AWS/Azure/GCP + vendor shelf). Combines a risk matrix, preflight QA checklist, copy variants to A/B test, and an unblock runbook for the last 10 days before publish. Intended audience: PMs, partner ops, solutions, legal SME, and the partner contact.

High-level goals:
- Get partner tile published with validated copy, passing security gating, and billing SKU mapped by beta end (T-10 days).
- Reduce false-reject rate during marketplace QA by 80% via standardized artifacts and sample responses.
- Surface 3 microcopy variants to experiment on onboarding conversion (trial opt-in) and measure CTR -> trial conversion.

Quick context + constraints:
- Partner requires single-tenant listing in cloud marketplaces; KMS requirement flagged (legal).
- Dedicated telemetry for usage attribution must be included (metering tags).
- Some assets still pending: localized tile screenshot (jp), quickstart video transcript.
- Tight timeline: partner build freeze 11/20 -> publication window 12/01-12/07.

Risk matrix (top risks and mitigations):
- Legal/KMS mismatch: risk=High. Mitigation: draft KMS statement + sample integration doc; escalate to security compliance (owner: Ruth).
- Billing SKU mis-map: risk=High. Mitigation: run SKU smoke in staging, map product codes and add fallback alias. (owner: Marcus).
- Tile copy failing compliance due to claims: risk=Medium. Mitigation: conservative copy variants, avoid performance claims >99% accuracy, include link to eval page. (owner: Priya).
- Screenshot or video violates customer data policy: risk=Medium. Mitigation: sanitize screenshots; use synthetic data demo. (owner: Daniel).
- QA flake on icons/asset sizes for GCP: risk=Low. Mitigation: automatic asset resizing script + preflight validator. (owner: Elena).

Preflight QA checklist (T-10 -> T-1):
- Assets: hero tile (1200x600), thumbnail (160x90), localized images (jp, de) present and verified. CHECK: image alt text included.
- Copy: 3 microcopy variants saved in copyboard, legal-approved blurb attached. CHECK: no unsubstantiated claims.
- SKU & Billing: SKU assigned and mapped to internal product code. CHECK: billing sandbox test passed.
- Tech Integration: deployment URL reachable, CORS and OAuth flows documented. CHECK: sample curl + auth token flow in repo.
- Metering: telemetry tags included. CHECK: sample event appears in staging ingestion.
- Security: KMS and data residency statement present. CHECK: security sign-off ticket exists.
- Accessibility: alt text and color contrast pass quick audit. CHECK: axe-core run attached.
- Marketplace-specific: provider checklists (AWS: Seller Central listing, Azure: Commercial Marketplace package, GCP: Partner Console) filled out. CHECK: screenshot proof pages.
- Legal/Docs: TOS snippet, privacy link, support contact. CHECK: legal sign-off + support runbook link.

Unblocking playbook (if any check fails):
1) Identify owner from checklist, tag on Slack #marketplace-onboard.
2) If asset missing (images, transcript) -> use placeholder: "coming-soon" plus alt text that meets accessibility. Document location: /marketplace/assets/temp/. (owner: Elena)
3) If billing fails: create a temporary alias SKU and schedule a backend reconcile job to reassign after publish. Keep partner informed. (owner: Marcus)
4) If legal objection to copy: fallback to conservative variant (V-c) and add eval link + footnote. (owner: Priya)
5) If security/kms unresolved: delay publish and open post-publish gated rollout to 5% with contract clause. Not ideal but last resort. (owner: Ruth)

Copy variants (microcopy) - goal: optimize CTA to increase trial opt-ins and reduce friction
- Hero title (short):
  A) "High-performance LLM inference for product teams"
  B) "Ship low-latency LLM features in production"
  C) "Predictable, low-cost LLM serving"
- Subtitle (supporting):
  A) "Hosted, dedicated and private deployments with built-in observability"
  B) "Seamless rollout, model fallbacks, and cost controls—ready for enterprise"
- CTA options:
  1) "Start a free trial"
  2) "Try in your cloud"
  3) "Request a dedicated demo"
- Test plan: A/B test hero title and CTA pair over 30 days post publish; primary metric: trial-start rate; secondary: tile CTR.

Sample tile copy (for listing & partner seller page):
- Short blurb (80-120 chars): "Redwood Inference: predictable, cost-efficient LLM serving across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Try a free trial."
- Long blurb (250-350 chars): "Redwood Inference combines a high-throughput runtime and deployment abstractions so engineering teams can ship LLM features with consistent latency and predictable cost. Features include streaming responses, model rollouts, KV caching, and private VPC options for regulated workloads. Get started with a free trial and real-world benchmarks."
- Feature bullets (3):
  - "Hosted API for fast time-to-value"
  - "Dedicated GPU pools with SLA-backed performance"
  - "Private deployments and KMS integrations for compliance"

Acceptance criteria (must pass to go live):
- All checklist items marked CHECK with evidence links in the linked_artifacts list.
- Partner-signed listing agreement submitted.
- Staging billing smoke test shows events for at least 3 token events.
- Legal and Security sign-off tickets closed.
- At least one microcopy CTA variant queued for post-publish experiment.

Metrics to track post-publish (initial 30 days):
- Tile impressions and CTR (daily)
- Trial-starts from marketplace (daily)
- Activation (trial->paid) at 30 days (cohort)
- Marketplace rejection incidents (bugs per publish) - target <=2 in first 30 days

Owner matrix and quick contacts: 
- Launch lead / contact: Elena Martinez (elena@redwood.com, slack: @elenam)
- Billing / SKU: Marcus Lee (marcus@redwood.com)
- Copy & messaging: Priya Nair (priya@redwood.com)
- Security/KMS: Ruth O'Connor (ruth@redwood.com)
- Partner-engagement: Daniel Ho (daniel@redwood.com)
- Legal reviewer: legal-marketplace@redwood.com

Open questions / decisions needed (T-6 days):
- Localized screenshots: partner to deliver jp image or do we synthetic-generate? (owner: partner/Elena).
- Support SLA listed on tile: should we include 24/7 or business hours? (owner: Daniel + Partner)
- Billing alias approach sign-off from finance for temporary SKU. (owner: Marcus)

Quick tasks & owners (next 72 hours):
- [ ] Finalize hero tile variants and submit to legal (Priya)
- [ ] Run billing sandbox and attach results to JIRA-PR-3108 (Marcus)
- [ ] Sanitize demo screenshots and upload localized placeholders (Daniel)
- [ ] Draft KMS statement and share with security (Ruth)
- [ ] Create experiment framework for CTA variants in analytics (Elena)

Notes to self (informal):
- If partner asks for aggressive claims, pull the "benchmarks" link and add qualifiers.
- Keep copy conservative for marketplace; use richer claims on our docs site and link out.
- Keep screenshots synthetic to speed localization.

Appendix: sample support runbook snippet (paste into support doc)
- Onboard sequence:
  1) Partner listing appears -> support receives webhook -> create internal incident with listing id.
  2) Verify SKU logs in billing ingestion; if missing escalate to Marcus.
  3) If user reports broken auth, check provider token -> escalate to infra-identity.

End of doc.
